title: Bear cub wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <circle cx='50' cy='9' r='4' fill='#ffe14d'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='22' r='2' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='26' r='2' fill='#ffd23f'/>

  <circle cx='30' cy='34' r='9' fill='#a9703f'/>

  <circle cx='30' cy='34' r='5' fill='#d99c63'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='34' r='5' fill='#d99c63'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='28' fill='#c98a52'/>

  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='58' r='4' fill='#ff8fa3' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='58' r='4' fill='#ff8fa3' opacity='0.85'/>
</svg>
